__help__:
Basics: click or drag a component from the left onto the canvas. When a component is selected, ＋ and × appear right on it; drag the gray bar on top to move it.
Typing: in an array type 2 7 11 (space or comma jumps to the next cell); in a string each character fills its own cell; press ⌫ in an empty cell to go back one cell.
Select: drag on empty space. ⌥ (Alt) + drag = drag out a copy, ⌘D duplicates the group below, ⌘C/⌘V pastes at the mouse position, Delete deletes, Shift + click a component to add it to the selection.
Shapes: in the bottom toolbar, rectangle R, circle O, line L, arrow ⇧L; drag to draw, hold Shift for a square / perfect circle / 45°. Click a shape to select, move, or recolor it.
Layers: with something selected, ⌘] bring forward, ⌘[ send backward, ⌘⌥] bring to front, ⌘⌥[ send to back (also ⤒ ⤓ in the toolbar).
Highlight: Shift + click a cell = yellow, Alt + click a cell = faded.
View: Space + drag or trackpad to pan; ⌘ + scroll wheel to zoom; ⇧1 fit all, ⇧0 100%.
